notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 L-6 cab, the 5,872-foot elevation, the Clearwater National Forest and the gone status. The distance from Kelly Creek ranger station also agrees across firelookout.com and the Forest Service list. The Forest Service list's Chateau Rock row says its patrol camp was 3 miles east atop Green Point; that describes another lookout's patrol camp, so I did not use it. No staffing history is documented in these sources, so the story leaves staffing out. The record's ground classification matches the statewide list. No photo or site description was found. Access is unknown; the site is on national forest land, but no source says whether the public may visit it. Story is about 125 words; the record is thin, so it stays short.
